exposure: Oxidative stress markers (MDA, SOD, CAT, GSH)
cohort: Healthy pregnant women and women with gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM).
finding: Women with GDM had higher serum levels of oxidative stress markers (MDA) and lower levels of antioxidant markers (SOD, CAT, GSH) compared to healthy pregnant women, and vitamin A deficiency further worsened oxidative stress in GDM women.
